# Hermes Agent FAQ & Troubleshooting Guide

## 1. Getting Started, UI & Observability
- **Web Dashboard:** Run `hermes dashboard` to launch the local web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`. The **Chat** tab embeds the full interactive terminal UI in your browser.
- **Observability & Tracing:** Langfuse is bundled as an opt-in plugin. Enable it with `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse` (or via `hermes tools`) to trace turn-level execution, parameters, and tool inputs/outputs.
- **Open WebUI Streaming:** Tool execution progress streams properly over SSE in current releases without dropped callbacks.
- **Reporting Security Issues:** Report vulnerabilities confidentially through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/security/advisories/new) or via email at `security@nousresearch.com` per `SECURITY.md`.

---

## 2. Model Providers & Configuration
- **Local Ollama Overridden by Remote API Keys:** Setting `provider: auto` scans environment variables and may prioritize keys like `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Force local execution in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`:
  ```yaml
  model:
    default: ollama/your-model
    provider: custom
    base_url: http://localhost:11434
  fallback_providers: []
  ```
- **Ollama Cloud 404 Errors:** Ollama Cloud uses OpenAI-compatible `/v1` routes (`https://ollama.com/v1`). Select the built-in `provider: ollama-cloud`.
- **Small Local Models (4B–9B) Responding Slowly:** Hermes injects the complete tool schema (~45 tools) on each API call. To boost performance:
  1. Disable unused toolsets with `hermes tools`.
  2. Use faster quantization or upgrade to a 32B+ model for tool-heavy workflows.
  3. Set `terminal.backend: local` to eliminate container overhead.
- **Vision Models on Custom/Local Endpoints:** Add `supports_vision: true` to your model entry in `config.yaml` to pass native image payloads.
- **Azure AI Foundry:** Run `hermes setup` or set `provider: azure-foundry` (auto-detects `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`). Claude Code-specific environment variables are ignored.
- **Claude Pro/Max vs. API Token Billing:** API keys are always billed on a pay-per-token basis by Anthropic. To use your Pro/Max subscription allowance, authenticate via OAuth.
- **Google Gemini:** Legacy CLI OAuth providers have been deprecated. Configure `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY` through Google AI Studio.
- **DeepSeek V4 Model Normalization:** Update to the latest release so `deepseek-v4-flash` is not normalized to `deepseek-chat` (which routes to the more expensive `deepseek-v4-pro`).
- **Token Tracking (LocalAI / OpenAI-Compatible):** Streaming requests automatically supply `stream_options: {include_usage: true}` so `/usage` correctly displays token counts.

---

## 3. Context, Memory & Task Execution
- **Core Identity & Memory Files:**
  - `SOUL.md`: Base agent persona, tone, and operational boundaries.
  - `USER.md`: Persistent user identity, background, and preferences (`target="user"`).
  - `MEMORY.md`: Long-term episodic memory and recalled facts.
- **Turn Limits & Long-Running Tasks:** Interactive conversation turns are capped by `agent.max_turns` (default: 90; CLI override: `--max-turns <N>`). For long autonomous tasks, use `/goal` to persist work across turns, and resume paused budgets with `/goal resume`.
- **Context Compaction:** `ContextCompressor` automatically prunes older tool output while retaining recent context. Custom engines can be configured via `context.engine`.
- **Skill Usage & Telemetry:** Skill invocations are tracked in `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json`. View execution statistics using `/insights` or `hermes insights`.
- **Local Honcho Memory:** Pointing `base_url` to `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` automatically injects a `"local"` placeholder key to bypass remote validation.

---

## 4. Messaging Gateways & Media Delivery
- **Interactive Setup:** Run `hermes gateway setup` for a guided CLI wizard to configure Discord, Telegram, Slack, Matrix, and other platforms.
- **Telegram "Unauthorized User" Rejections:** `allowed_chats` only filters group chats. To authorize direct messages:
  - Add your numerical Telegram user ID to `telegram.allow_from` in `config.yaml`.
  - Or DM the bot, get a pairing code, and run: `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`.
  - Or set `telegram.allow_all: true` to permit all users.
- **Per-Channel Personas:** Define distinct system prompts per channel ID using `channel_prompts` in your platform configuration.
- **Multi-Profile Multiplexing:** Run multiple distinct bots/accounts (e.g., Weixin, Telegram) under a single multiplexed gateway process with isolated sessions, memory, and skills.
- **Media & File Delivery:** Inbound `.txt` and `.py` files are injected directly into context. Outbound files are automatically dispatched to Matrix (`m.file`), Telegram, and Email (SMTP attachments). Remote DingTalk images render via `![image](url)` Markdown, and MCP image outputs (`MEDIA:<path>`) forward directly to supported chat apps.
- **Session Continuity:** Interrupted sessions enter a `resume_pending` state instead of wiping history. Automated reset is opt-in (`session_reset.mode: none` by default).

---

## 5. Extensibility & Development
- **Model Routing Policy:** Complexity-based dynamic routing (`smart_model_routing`) is not supported. Subagent models are configured via `delegation.provider` / `delegation.model`, and primary models can be switched manually via `/model` or `hermes chat -m <model>`.
- **Subagents:** Launch parallel worker agents using the `delegate_task` tool (default concurrency: 3).
- **Custom Tools:** Add personal tools as plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/` and enable them via `hermes plugins enable <name>`. Built-in tools are registered in `tools/` and must be exposed in `toolsets.py`.
- **Memory Providers:** In-tree additions to `plugins/memory/` are closed. Third-party backends must be published as external plugins implementing the `MemoryProvider` ABC (`sync_turn`, `prefetch`, `shutdown`).

---

## 6. Installation & Platform Notes
- **Native Windows 10/11:** Tier 1 supported via PowerShell (`install.ps1`). WSL2 is only needed if using the POSIX PTY terminal pane in the web dashboard.
- **NAS & Docker Permissions:** Set `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID`/`HERMES_GID`) to avoid `[Errno 13] Permission denied` errors on bind mounts (`/opt/data`). Multi-arch Docker images natively support `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`.
- **Android (Termux):** Fully supported via `scripts/install.sh` using the dedicated `.[termux-all]` dependencies and writable `TMPDIR`.
- **Slow Updates:** Pauses during the Node.js step of `hermes update` occur while Camofox silently downloads browser binaries.
